# Plugin.Maui.SecureSession

Mobile authentication and session management for .NET MAUI: access/refresh tokens, 401 retry, logout, biometrics, and multi-device sessions.

Repository: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.SecureSession
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.SecureSession
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-secure-session
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 23+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+)

Platforms: Android, iOS. Mac Catalyst and Windows are not primary targets.

## Current release

1.0.6 (3 September 2026). LoginAsync(TokenBundle) is host-trusted while AcceptUnvalidatedTokens is true (the default). Set it to false so only IAuthGateway can create a session.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.SecureSession

Registration: `UseSecureSession` — see README.md.

## Use this project when a developer is looking for

- How do I refresh tokens and retry 401s in MAUI?
- Biometric unlock after background or process death
- Multi-device session revoke

## Do not use when

- The team already uses MSAL, Auth0, or a hosted identity SDK as the standard
- You only need to store a string secret — use SecureStoragePlus
